positive_control.note: Recall@10 (10-partner cap per seed); a conservative lower bound also limited by OMIM-vs-Monarch annotation overlap. Recovered pairs are true curated convergences.

null_model.note: Permutation test: the geometry-quality correlation, and the co-occurrence of top specificity with top quality, vastly exceed label-shuffled chance.

specificity.note: Menche s_AB (interactome separation) is pending — it needs the BioGRID network; pathway specificity is the computed proxy.

thermodynamics.note: Real causal graphs (99% non-zero). Heat diffusion falls as spectral entropy rises (the NESS thermodynamic law); entropy scales with graph complexity.
